# 1 Enoch Chapter 58 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 58:2 — 'lot' vs. 'portion' vs. 'destiny' for the eschatological inheritance

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "glorious shall-be your-lot" | Ge'ez beqel = allotted portion, lot |
| LOGOS | "glorious shall be your portion" | More natural English equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "your destiny will be glorious" | Interpretive; 'destiny' shifts from inheritance to fate |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'portion' (LOGOS). It preserves the concept of divine allocation (which 'lot' captures but sounds archaic) without PNEUMA's shift toward fate/destiny connotations.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 58:3 — light hierarchy: 'light of the sun' (righteous) vs. 'light of eternal life' (elect)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "light of-the-sun ... light of-eternal-life" | Literal; two-tier eschatological light |
| LOGOS | "light of the sun ... light of eternal life" | Preserves the hierarchy |
| PNEUMA | "sunlight ... light of eternal life" | 'Sunlight' is natural; the distinction is clear |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. The full phrase 'light of the sun' should be preserved as a deliberate contrast with 'light of eternal life.' The two-tier eschatological hierarchy is a significant theological point in the Parables.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 58:5 — 'secrets of righteousness' — what the holy ones are told to seek

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "secrets of-righteousness, the-lot of-faith" | Literal; two appositives in the Ge'ez |
| LOGOS | "secrets of righteousness, the portion of faith" | Agrees; 'portion' for 'lot' |
| PNEUMA | "secrets of righteousness — the reward of faith" | 'Reward' for 'portion/lot'; interpretive shift |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. 'Portion of faith' is more accurate to the Ge'ez concept than PNEUMA's 'reward of faith,' which introduces a merit-and-reward framework not clearly present in the original.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 58:6 — 'uprightness' vs. 'integrity' for the light that endures forever

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "light of-uprightness" | Literal; Ge'ez sened/qedama = upright, straight |
| LOGOS | "light of uprightness" | Agrees |
| PNEUMA | "light of integrity" | 'Integrity' is a natural synonym with moral connotations |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's 'uprightness' as it more precisely echoes the legal/ethical range of the Ge'ez term. 'Integrity' (PNEUMA) is acceptable but slides toward a personality quality rather than a positional righteousness.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
